test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

In America, / most of the people / can speak / the English well.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **The English well**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is the use of the definite article 'the' before English in the phrase 'the English well'.
 
• In English, when referring to languages, the definite article 'the' is not used. Therefore, 'the English' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should simply be 'English well', without the definite article.

Correcting the error, the sentence should read: *"In America, most of the people can **speak English** well."*
